invariants.rationale: Methods returning metadata typically should not produce null results; a valid HoodieWriteMetadata is expected.
The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata, so the result should be an instance of that class.
The logCompactionInstantTime parameter is forwarded as a required argument and likely must be non-null.
A valid (non-null) HoodieEngineContext is generally required for table actions.
HoodieWriteMetadata#getWriteStatuses (when available) should return a non-null value representing write results.
